params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of Lookup Tables to retrieve per page.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: Token to supply for multi page retrievals.

params.name: codes
params.description: List of Lookup Table codes to retrieve.

params.name: additional
params.description: Comma separated list of additional non-default fields to be included in the response. For example,if you want to include the active Revision for each of the Lookup Tables returned, set `additional=activeRevision` in the query.

items.docs:
Retrieve a list Lookup Tables created for the Organization:
* Returned list can be filtered by Lookup Table `code` query parameter.
* If you want to include any non-default fields for the returned Lookup Tables, use the additional query parameter to specify which you want to include in the response.
